name: cf-income-tax
description: Use this Central African Republic individual income tax Guide for 2026 research on resident employees, sole traders and people receiving investment income. It separates the salary scale from business profit taxation, shows the salary deductions, explains the turnover minimum and identifies foreign income and personal capital gains as distinct questions. Search triggers include IRPP, Bangui salary tax, self-employed tax, agricultural profit, foreign assets and annual income return. The fetched official code is a 2023 edition, not a current consolidated text. The stated source limits and unresolved later-law checks must be cleared before using its baseline calculations for a live filing.
